finding.scenario: Parent receives handled SIGTERM/SIGINT after its last work checkpoint, during cleanup or final evidence persistence.
finding.observedSource: request_stop only sets stopping/stopSignal. persist_results computes PASS from errors, cleanup, and worker exit; none reads stopping. Return reads report.state only.
finding.impact: A cooperatively stopped attempt can report PASS/exit0 if its work already exited successfully. Existing cleanup still runs; this is terminal evidence classification, not evidence of a leaked process or failed product behavior.
requiredRepair: Keep stopping and report signal; make a handled soft-stop fail the terminal outcome even during cleanup/final writes.
Restore original signal handlers in an outer finally so a final persistence exception cannot bypass restoration.
Keep all original b5 preparation/binding/review artifacts, original b4 runtime files, product source, budget20609/39391 and cleanup behavior.
Rebind only changed executable preparation metadata. No new browser/runtime or native authorization request.
